## Device and tests

<!-- Example: PC RTX 5080 16 GB, Ollama and llama.cpp, classes S and M, full scope -->

## Checklist

- [ ] One new file in `runs/`, named `<date>-<device>.md`
- [ ] First line is `# YYYY-MM-DD: <device>`, with the same device name as earlier runs of this device
- [ ] Test cards under `## Tests` with headings `### <engine> <version>, <model> <quantization> (<class>)`
- [ ] No changes to the generated parts of `README.md` or to `charts/`
- [ ] No names, host names, IP addresses, user paths or serial numbers in the file

## Deviations from the standard run

<!-- Not restarted, programs left open, monitor on the GPU, other quantization, custom engine build ... Write "none" if there are none. -->
